name: Runaway Princess

start.dialog: I'm... not supposed to be here. I ran from my kingdom. But I need to send a message home. To my mother. The couriers won't help a 'commoner.' Will you deliver it for me?
start.objective: Deliver Garnet's sealed letter to the royal courier in the capital

progress.dialog: The letter... it's to my mother. Explaining why I left. Please, don't read it. It's... private.
progress.objective: Travel to the capital and find the royal courier

complete.dialog: You delivered it? Thank you. I was so worried. Here - my royal pendant. It's all I have left from home. It will protect you in dangerous places.

party_comments.kade: Running from royalty to find yourself. I get that.
party_comments.korr: Royalty fleeing their duties. Common enough in troubled times.
party_comments.twist: A princess! I knew she looked fancy!

hidden_outcome: If you return with a response from her mother (forgiving her), Garnet gives you the 'Summoner's Horn' - an item that boosts all summon damage
